text:
kevin: Heads-up — saw a 2.3x tail-latency blip in decode for p99 on gpu-pool-7 around 02:14 UTC. Looks correlated with KV-cache drains when a large prefill batch completes.

maria: Can you paste the trace? is this the same handshake contention we saw last month? :thinking_face:

kevin: Trace attached below. It's not identical. The prefill->decode handshake is stalling on the batcher lock while KV eviction runs. stack shows a busy loop waiting on kv_drain_cond.

perf-bot: 
```
PROFILE sample @ 2026-03-15T02:14:12Z
hotspots:
  - batcher::handshake_wait  42.1%
  - kv_cache::drain_sync     28.7%
  - kernel_selector::probe   9.3%
  - scheduler::choose_queue  6.4%
```

anya: That matches the timing of a large prefill finishing. Proposal: separate prefill and decode batch formation threads + soft handshake (0.5ms backoff) to avoid lock contention. Also reduce decode token_budget when pending kv_drain > 0.

maria: How do you compute token_budget now? any quick patch we can try in staging?

anya: Current rule: `token_budget = max(8, int(0.2 * avg_seq))` — naive. Patch idea:
```
if kv_drain_inflight:
  token_budget = max(4, int(0.1 * avg_seq))
elif prefill_pending > 5:
  token_budget = max(6, int(0.15 * avg_seq))
else:
  token_budget = max(8, int(0.25 * avg_seq))
```
This smooths decode burstiness during drains.

kevin: I ran a microbenchmark on staging with that patch + separated batcher threads. Results: p99 decode dropped from 420ms -> 220ms; mean unchanged. However prefill latency went up 8% under heavy traffic, so we need a QoS policy to not starve prefill.

jess: Can we try a handshake cooldown window instead of hard split? e.g., after a prefill completes, hold handshake for 1ms to let KV buffering finish. Might reduce prefill regression.

anya: Sure — combining soft handshake (1ms), token_budget smoothing, and prioritizing prefill queue for the first 2 tokens seems reasonable. Test matrix: A) split threads only, B) soft-handshake + smoothing, C) both.

maria: I'll add A/B/C to the perf dashboard and schedule a 10% canary rollout for B first. Please include metric: p99_decode, p99_prefill, kv_eviction_time, handshake_wait_ms.

kevin: Command I'll use for canary deploy: `/deploy batcher/handshake-smoothing --canary=10% --tag=20260315-exp1` (will run 30m windows). Will post results.

jess: +1 on metrics. Also add a synthetic load with 80/20 prefill/decode split to stress kv.

kevin: Running now. Posting logs in this thread once the first window completes. :rocket:

perf-bot: Test harness queued: test_id=exp-batcher-20260315, expected run 30m, notify on completion.

maria: Thanks team — if results look good we can roll B -> 30% and then evaluate C.

kevin: Initial 5m into canary: p99_decode down ~45%, kv_eviction_time down ~30%. Prefill p99 +3% so far. Will report full window.
